IE-N5.scope_note: The syllabus exam-scope line lists modules 1–7. Its weighting table gives Module 8 (LCDs) 10%, and the syllabus includes LCD learning outcomes. Confirm exam scope with your college.

modules.name: Alternating Current Theory
modules.study_focus: Compare RC and RL differentiators and integrators. Sketch their responses and practise coupling, resonance and impedance calculations.
local_files: Industrial Electronics/N5/01 AC and RLC/Module 01 Alternating current theory.pdf
Industrial Electronics/N5/01 AC and RLC/CHAPTER 01 TUT.pdf

modules.name: Power Supplies
modules.study_focus: Trace the supply from transformer through rectifier, filter and regulator. Calculate DC output, ripple and peak inverse voltage.
local_files: Industrial Electronics/N5/02 Power Supplies/Module 02 Power supplies.pdf
Industrial Electronics/N5/02 Power Supplies/CHAPTER 02 POWER SUPPLIES FULL LESSON.pptx

modules.name: Amplifiers
modules.study_focus: Explain transistor bias and amplifier operation using circuit diagrams. Work through gain and feedback calculations.

modules.name: Integrated Circuits and Transducers
modules.study_focus: Explain integrated-circuit applications and compare transducer operating principles. Practise calculations involving thermistors and bridge circuits.
local_files: Industrial Electronics/N5/04 Integrated Circuits and Transducers/Module 04 integrated circuits and transducers.pdf
Industrial Electronics/N5/04 Integrated Circuits and Transducers/integratd circuits.pdf

modules.name: Electronic Phase Control
modules.study_focus: Compare SCR and TRIAC switching. Interpret triggering circuits and phase-controlled waveforms, including feedback control.

modules.name: Measuring Instruments
modules.study_focus: Distinguish analogue from digital signals. Explain frequency counters and compare digital voltmeter operating principles.

modules.name: Oscillators
modules.study_focus: Explain feedback and LC oscillation, calculate oscillator frequency and compare multivibrator and 555 timer modes.

modules.name: Liquid Crystal Displays
modules.study_focus: Explain how an LCD operates and draw a labelled construction diagram. Identify design factors and advantages.

modules.name: Limits and Continuity
modules.study_focus: Evaluate limits using appropriate simplifications and check where functions are continuous.
local_files: Mathematics/N5/Limits and Continuity/Chapter 1 Limits lesson 1 N5 .pdf

modules.name: Differentiation
modules.study_focus: Differentiate expressions using the module's rules and practise choosing the right rule for composite expressions.

modules.name: Applications of Differentiation
modules.study_focus: Use derivatives to analyse curves and solve applied problems. Explain what the derivative says about the quantity in the problem.

modules.name: Integration Techniques
modules.study_focus: Choose a method before integrating. Practise inspection, substitution, trigonometric identities, algebraic fractions, partial fractions and integration by parts.

modules.name: The Definite Integral
modules.study_focus: Evaluate definite integrals using bounds. Check the sign and interpret the result in context.

modules.name: Applications of the Definite Integral: Areas and Volumes
modules.study_focus: Set up integrals for areas and volumes. Identify the bounds and axis of rotation before calculating.

modules.name: Second Moment of Area and Moment of Inertia
modules.study_focus: Set up second-moment calculations about the specified axis. Distinguish area moment from mass moment and check the units.
modules.topic: Second moment of area and moment of inertia

modules.name: Differential Equations
modules.study_focus: Solve first-order equations by integration or separation. Use given conditions to obtain particular solutions of second-order equations.
